mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE rises by >0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST decline for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS and HOUST decline for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO), a concurrent rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals an imminent recession, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during recessionary regimes (defined by INDPRO decline and UNRATE rise).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) over the past 3 quarters signals a weakening economy, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth declines for 3 consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3.0 percentage points signals accelerating inflation, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed is expected to tighten policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) over the past month indicate a rapidly deteriorating labor market, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise for 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises for 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong industrial production growth (INDPRO above 2% annualized) and low unemployment (UNRATE below 4.5%), the economy is in a strong expansion phase, which predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO growth is above 2% annualized and UNRATE is below 4.5%.
